source_clauses: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
It should hold about twenty of them
release exactly one each time I press a lever
so I never get two at once.
I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
It must not jam when it is nearly empty.

requirements.statement: Dispenser must hold about twenty small items.
Dispenser must release exactly one small item each time a lever is pressed.
Dispenser must never release two items at once.
Dispenser must be refillable from the top without removing it from the wall.
Dispenser must not jam when nearly empty.

scenarios.description: User presses lever to release an item.
User refills dispenser from top while it is mounted.

ambiguities: The exact number of items in 'about twenty' is not defined.

assumptions: The 'small items' are uniform in size and shape.
The dispenser is manually operated by pressing a lever.
The dispenser is intended for indoor use.
